equality_gate.basis: inline legs vs engine.confluence_tiers.tier_stream, every name, every in-range cell

section_1_per_leg_isolation.question: for each not-topped leg separately, what does the cohort blocked SOLELY by that leg do forward, against the cohort the gate admitted?
section_1_per_leg_isolation.predicate: SOLE[L] = L & ~sibling_a & ~sibling_b & tier_reachable — blocked, blocked by L alone, and admitted the moment L is removed

windows.full_frame: every name-day in the frozen frame carrying h forward sessions (primary — the horizon ladder needs the depth)
windows.battery_window: the last 126 sessions with full H=10 forward coverage — #4547 section_2's own window, replayed here so the two instruments can be read cell against cell

section_2_failopen_and_contamination.question: the 3D RSI-MACD needs 232 daily bars and `macd_bear = m3n < s3n` reads False on NaN — how many name-days ran with that leg unevaluated, and is any measurement of the leg taken on a biased subset because of it?

engine_constants.source: engine/confluence_tiers.py l.87-103 (LEG_WARMUP_BARS, GATING_LEGS, YOUNG_HISTORY_BARS) — read from the engine, not restated

section_2_failopen_and_contamination.direction_note: the fail-open cannot make the leg FIRE — below 232 bars both operands are NaN, so `macd_bear` is False. It therefore cannot contaminate the SOLE:macd_bear cohort. What it contaminates is the ADMITTED control: rows let through on two evaluated legs plus one that never ran.

sole_blocker_cohort_purity.note: must be 0 — a leg that reads False on NaN cannot fire below its warm-up. A non-zero here is an instrument defect.

prereg_study_contamination.evidence: l.150-153 skips any fire whose k3/d3/m3/s3 are not all finite (`if not all(np.isfinite(x) ...): continue`) BEFORE the dedup anchor is advanced, so every graded fire had the 3D RSI-MACD computable. The keep-rule failure was measured where the leg actually evaluates.

deep_probe.question: on the admitted rows inside the fail-open band, what does the 3D RSI-MACD read once the name is given adequate history?
deep_probe.method: recompute macd_bear on the yahoo-spliced series and read it on the same calendar dates, restricted to rows where the leg is computable on the deep series and NOT on the production cache series
deep_probe.caveat: _tf_bars resamples on 3B buckets anchored on the series' FIRST index date, so the spliced series' bucket boundaries differ from production's. This probe answers 'would an adequately-warmed name have read bearish here', not 'production's own leg would have read X'.

positive_control_warm_rows.basis: bars >= 232, stoch legs clean, tier reachable — the same row shape, where the leg genuinely evaluates

date_matched_control.basis: the same warm rows, restricted to the SESSIONS the probe drew from — removes the band's calendar concentration from the comparison

deep_probe.read: the DIRECTION is what this probe supports — a large share of band admissions carried a 3D RSI-MACD that was in fact bearish. The exact share is not transferable: the phase caveat above and the band's calendar concentration both push on the level, which is why the date-matched control and a conservative floor are printed beside it.

section_3_forfeiture_pricing.question: if macd_bear were removed, what does the board ADMIT that it does not today — how many, and how does that added cohort grade?
section_3_forfeiture_pricing.identity: the added cohort is exactly SOLE:macd_bear — removing L admits L & ~siblings & tier_reachable and nothing else
